reading_speed.description: Standard adult academic reading speed baseline (~210 words per minute).

dwell_time.description: Fraction of expected dwell time (words / words_per_second) below which a section is flagged as skimmed if scroll speed is also elevated.
dwell_time.description_absolute: Absolute minimum seconds spent on any section with more than 20 words.

scroll_speed.description: Max continuous scroll speed in px/s before scroll pattern is flagged as rapid scrolling.
scroll_speed.description_relative: Ratio of scroll speed relative to text density (px/sec / (words / section_height_px)) that triggers Skimmed classification.

reread.description: Revisiting a section after reading subsequent sections, with dwell time >= 4.0 seconds on the second pass, classifies it as Reread.

edge_cases.description: Pages with fewer than 25 words (diagrams, title pages) require at least 3 seconds of dwell to be considered Genuinely Read.
